description: Nombre de places de stationnement PMR à Issy-les-Moulineaux is a dataset listed in Issy-les-moulineaux open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a city, published or maintained by Ville d'Issy-les-Moulineaux. Ce jeu recense le nombre de places de stationnement réservées pour les personnes à mobilité réduite (PMR) de 2016 à 2019. Coverage: Issy-les-Moulineaux. The portal files it under Transports, Déplacements, Services, Social. Its keywords are handicap, PMR, parking, dataviz1, stationnement, GPSO. The portal shows 4 records. The portal shows 2020-07-24 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence Ouverte (Etalab) (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/wp-content/uploads/2014/05/Licence_Ouverte.pdf). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-issy-com-portal.
